messages:
Casey: quick heads-up: noticed handbook/quickstarts/model-deploy.md has a dead relative shortlink in the 'example run' section -> points to ../examples/old-run.md which 404s. no owner in frontmatter. who can take?
Ivy: I can grab this. do we prefer replacing the shortlink with the canonical absolute path or add an anchor redirect on the target?
Casey: prefer replace on the referencing page to reduce redirects. also add owner frontmatter. small PR is fine.
docs-bot: automated-scan: missing-owner & broken-internal-link detected (handbook/quickstarts/model-deploy.md) rule=docs.link-health. recommended action: add owner frontmatter and update link to /handbook/examples/run-examples.md#run.
Ivy: plan: 1) add `owner: @Ivy` to top of file, 2) update link to absolute path `/handbook/examples/run-examples.md#run`, 3) run local docs-lint and include a tiny changelog. will open PR in a single commit.
Sam: ping me for a quick CR, I'll check the link targets and run the local smoke build.
Ivy: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13131 title: "assign owner + fix shortlink -> absolute run-examples" 
Sam: quick review done, left 1 nit about anchor casing. Ivy pushed fix. CI green.
Casey: merged, thanks team. docs-bot: changelog: handbook/quickstarts/model-deploy.md updated (owner=@Ivy) broken-link resolved.
Ivy: done, leaving a note in #eng-standup about the fix and reminding folks to use absolute /handbook paths for cross-doc links.
